catalogue.family_purpose: Exercise rider pursuit, attacks, memory and lifecycle.

description: Does a rider retain identity and plausible knowledge when sight breaks? Use the declared rider lanes. Create visible movement then real occlusion, allow meaningful game time and cross the relevant loading/reload boundary.

steps.label: native_rider_band_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: two identified hostile riders load to the native World

steps.label: audit_saved_rider_band_time
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon footing

steps.label: audit_saved_rider_band_open_lanes
steps.abort_reason: fixture lacks the native reciprocal lanes or southward hiding path

steps.label: audit_saved_identified_rider_band_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove the direct and relay riders

steps.label: operate_native_rider_band_continuity
steps.objective: Does a rider retain identity and plausible knowledge when sight breaks? Use the declared rider lanes. Create visible movement then real occlusion, allow meaningful game time and cross the relevant loading/reload boundary. Success boundary: Sight-driven pursuit changes when sight is lost; identity, ammunition and bounded last-known knowledge survive without omniscient reacquisition.
proof_targets: bounded shared old-location evidence after real sight loss
invariants: accepted replacement proof is predecessor evidence and is not replayed
no injected membership, observation, destination or attack
false convergence and blocked-route controls retain separate verdicts

steps.label: save_native_rider_band_for_replacement
steps.objective: Use the advertised native Save and Quit path, then Main-menu Quit and its native confirmation, so the encounter-derived band and bounded evidence cross a real replacement-process boundary.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved native world reaches Main menu and the original rider process exits before replacement

steps.label: audit_relaunched_native_rider_band_actors
steps.abort_reason: replacement process did not reload both tagged riders from the saved world

steps.label: observe_relaunched_native_rider_band
steps.objective: Observe the replacement native world only. The read-only band diagnostic must retain the same tagged actor IDs, one encounter-derived registry membership, revision and any unexpired bounded evidence. Finish for exact cleanup.
proof_targets: persisted band registry membership and bounded evidence

evidence_contract.claim: two native zombie riders form a durable encounter-derived band, share only bounded direct prey evidence, and apply later cooperative pressure without a shortcut
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native movement/turn receipts plus fixture-gated read-only diagnostic and replacement-process audit are required

playtest_recipe.title: Rider sight loss and continuity
playtest_recipe.question: Does a rider retain identity and plausible knowledge when sight breaks?

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Use the declared rider lanes. Create visible movement then real occlusion, allow meaningful game time and cross the relevant loading/reload boundary.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: Sight-driven pursuit changes when sight is lost; identity, ammunition and bounded last-known knowledge survive without omniscient reacquisition.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
